_operating_mode: ONE session model exclusively (claude-opus-4-8[1m]); every agent() inherits it, no pins, no downgrade. FULL ULTRACODE POOLS per non-trivial unit: re-ground -> design -> 3-lens adversarial verify ALWAYS -> 3-vote -> implement -> 5-gate -> tag + flip JSON + push; capstone loops til 2 dry (cap 4). _confidence_calibration: <90% -> BLOCKERS + pivot; 90-96% -> proceed + note the alternative in the commit; >=97% -> proceed. Human-locked picks immutable -> if one looks wrong, BLOCKERS HIGH + pivot, never override.

self_heal.FM-3: ambiguous/uncitable canon -> 'I don't see this in the log' -> BLOCKERS + pivot. Never invent a locked decision.
